policy: Original assistant editorial suggestions for human review, not replacements of the frozen 1000-word shortlist. Oxford word/POS and Cambridge search snippets do not prove exact-sense CEFR. No approval, no live change.

original_snapshot.english_definition: The ability to control or influence what happens.
original_snapshot.example_sentence: The manager has the power to approve requests.

proposal.english_definition: The authority or right to make a decision or take action.
proposal.example_sentence: The manager has the power to approve requests.

candidates.rationale: Original 'စွမ်းအား' can imply physical energy; manager's approval right is authority. Cambridge indexed CONTROL B2 is not necessarily this exact sense; requires human publisher review.

original_snapshot.english_definition: One of the surfaces or edges of an object.
original_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ဘေးဘက်၊ တစ်ဖက်
original_snapshot.example_sentence: Write your name on this side of the paper.

proposal.english_definition: One of the flat surfaces of an object.
proposal.burmese_meaning: မျက်နှာပြင်တစ်ဖက်၊ ဘက်တစ်ဖက်
proposal.example_sentence: Please write your name on this side of the paper.

candidates.rationale: Paper has two faces; the original 'edge' wording can incorrectly suggest the thin border.

original_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ဘာမှမရှိခြင်း၊ ဘာတစ်ခုမှမဟုတ်ခြင်း
original_snapshot.example_sentence: There was nothing in the empty box.

proposal.burmese_meaning: ဘာတစ်ခုမှ မရှိခြင်း၊ ဘာမှမရှိ
proposal.example_sentence: There was nothing inside the box.

candidates.rationale: Remove 'empty box' tautology; Myanmar must be natural when used with negative predicates.

original_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: တစ်ခုလုံးသော၊ အပြည့်အစုံဖြစ်သော
original_snapshot.example_sentence: We spent the whole afternoon cleaning the classroom.

proposal.english_definition: All of something, with no part left out.
proposal.burmese_meaning: တစ်ခုလုံး၊ အပြည့်အစုံ
proposal.example_sentence: We spent the whole afternoon cleaning the classroom.

candidates.rationale: 'Whole afternoon' is the entire duration, not physically complete parts; reviewer should check context-sensitive Myanmar.

original_snapshot.english_definition: A smaller amount of something that cannot usually be counted.
original_snapshot.example_sentence: Please add less sugar to my tea.

proposal.burmese_meaning: ပိုနည်းသော ပမာဏ၊ လျော့နည်းသော
proposal.example_sentence: Please put less sugar in my tea.

candidates.rationale: Use less with uncountable sugar; do not confuse fewer + plural count nouns. Cambridge indexed A2 is not a direct-page receipt.

original_snapshot.english_definition: Work involving buying, selling, or providing goods and services.
original_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: စီးပွားရေးလုပ်ငန်း၊ ကုန်သွယ်မှု
original_snapshot.example_sentence: Her family runs a small business near the market.

proposal.english_definition: An activity or organisation that sells goods or services.
proposal.example_sentence: Her family runs a small business near the market.

candidates.rationale: 'ကုန်သွယ်မှု' may imply trade rather than the small family business in the example; Oxford word/POS A1 conflicts with provisional A2.

original_snapshot.english_definition: Used to introduce a fact that contrasts with what was just said.
original_snapshot.example_sentence: The room was small; however, it was comfortable.

proposal.english_definition: Used to introduce information that contrasts with an earlier statement.
proposal.example_sentence: The room was small. However, it was comfortable.

candidates.rationale: Two-sentence example highlights sentence adverb and punctuation; Oxford word/POS A1 requires A2 sense review.

original_snapshot.english_definition: People in a community or society in general.
original_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ပြည်သူလူထု
original_snapshot.example_sentence: The library is open to the public.

proposal.english_definition: People in a community or society as a whole.
proposal.burmese_meaning: အများပြည်သူ၊ လူထု
proposal.example_sentence: The library is open to the public.

candidates.rationale: Noun 'the public', not adjective 'public'; Myanmar 'အများပြည်သူ' is natural in public-access context.

original_snapshot.english_definition: Something that is known or proved to be true.
original_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: အမှန်တကယ်ဖြစ်သောအချက်၊ အချက်အလက်အမှန်
original_snapshot.example_sentence: It is a fact that plants need water.

proposal.english_definition: Something that is true and can be checked.
proposal.burmese_meaning: အမှန်တကယ်ဖြစ်သော အချက်၊ အချက်အလက်အမှန်
proposal.example_sentence: That is a fact, not a guess.

candidates.rationale: Avoid stilted 'It is a fact that plants need water'; Oxford word/POS A1 requires A2 sense justification.

original_snapshot.english_definition: One of two equal parts of something.
original_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: နှစ်ပိုင်းညီညီခွဲထားသည့် တစ်ပိုင်း၊ တစ်ဝက်
original_snapshot.example_sentence: She ate half of the sandwich.

proposal.english_definition: One of two equal parts of something.
proposal.burmese_meaning: တစ်ဝက်၊ နှစ်ပိုင်းညီညီထဲက တစ်ပိုင်း
proposal.example_sentence: She ate half of the sandwich.

candidates.rationale: The natural Myanmar gloss is short; check whether half of the sandwich functions as a noun phrase or quantifier.

original_snapshot.english_definition: A series of lessons about a particular subject.
original_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ဘာသာရပ်တစ်ခုကို သင်ကြားပေးသော သင်တန်း
original_snapshot.example_sentence: She enrolled in a short English course.

proposal.english_definition: A series of lessons about one subject.
proposal.burmese_meaning: သင်တန်း၊ သင်ခန်းစာများဆက်တိုက်သင်ယူရသော အစီအစဉ်
proposal.example_sentence: She signed up for an English course.

candidates.rationale: Disambiguate study course from route/meal course; Oxford noun A1 conflicts with provisional A2.

original_snapshot.english_definition: Facts or details that help someone understand something.
original_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: သတင်းအချက်အလက်၊ သိရှိရန်အချက်အလက်
original_snapshot.example_sentence: The notice gives information about the new bus route.

proposal.english_definition: Facts or details about a person, thing or event.
proposal.burmese_meaning: အချက်အလက်များ၊ သတင်းအချက်အလက်
proposal.example_sentence: The notice gives information about the new bus route.

candidates.rationale: 'Information' is uncountable; original extended Myanmar gloss was unnatural. Oxford noun A1 conflicts with provisional A2.
